competences.description: Attacks the enemy to inflict damage that increases according to your MAX HP and absorbs the Attack Bar by 15% with a 50% chance.

effets.description: Steal ATB from the enemy and add it to yourself

competences.description: Removes all beneficial effects granted on the selected enemy target, and then attacks all enemies with an attack that deals more damage according to your MAX HP to stun them for 1 turn with a 50% chance. Enemies defeated by this attack and enemies already defeated when this attack is used cannot be revived during battle.

effets.description: Removes one or more beneficial effects from target monster(s)
The target will be stunned and won't be able to attack.
Prevents an enemy from being resurrected after being killed.

competences.description: Absorbs the Attack Bar of all enemies by 30%. Afterwards, attacks all enemies to decrease their Attack Speed for 2 turns, dealing damage in proportion to the amount of absorbed Attack Bar and your MAX HP.

effets.description: Steal ATB from the enemy and add it to yourself
The target's Attack Speed will be decreased by 30%.
